description: This file defines a React functional component 'Sidebar' that renders a collapsible sidebar menu with categorized menu items for navigation. It imports icons from '@ant-design/icons' and UI components from 'antd'. It organizes menu items into groups with role-based access control, dynamically builds menu items, and manages URL navigation state.

methods.name: navigateToPage
methods.description: Updates the browser URL query parameter 'page' and calls the setPage callback to change the current view.

methods.name: filterItemsByRole
methods.description: Filters menu items based on the user's role to enforce role-based access control.

methods.name: buildMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs the menu items for the Ant Design Menu component based on user role, menu groups, and collapse state.

methods.name: findMenuItemKey
methods.description: Finds the menu item key that corresponds to the current page, used to set the selected menu item.
